parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

🌱
accident[æksidənt]n.
An accident is an unexpected undesirable event. (Tai nạn là một sự kiện không mong muốn xảy ra bất ngờ.)
➔ She had to go to the hospital after she was in a serious car accident.
🌱
admiral[ædmərəl]n.
An admiral is someone who controls many military ships. (Đô đốc là người điều khiển nhiều tàu quân sự.)
➔ They won the sea battle because of the admiral's great leadership.
🌱
arc[a:rk]n.
An arc is a curved shape. (Hình cung là một hình dạng cong.)
➔ A rainbow has the shape of an arc.
🌱
character[kærəktər]n.
Your character is your personality. (Tính cách của bạn là nhân cách của bạn.)
➔ My sister's character is fun and very outgoing.
🌱
conscience[kɑnʃəns]n.
Your conscience is your inner sense of what is right and wrong. (Lương tâm của bạn là cảm giác sâu thẳm bên trong về điều gì đúng và sai.)
➔ I recycle everything I can, so my conscience is clear!
🌱
fiery[faiəri]adj.
If something is fiery, it is burning strongly. (Nếu một thứ gì đó "fiery" (bốc cháy dữ dội), nó đang cháy rất mạnh mẽ.)
➔ The fiery blaze burned all night long.
🌱
flesh[fleʃ]n.
Flesh is the skin, muscle and fat on your body. (Thịt (trên cơ thể) là da, cơ bắp và mỡ trên cơ thể bạn.)
➔ The zebra's flesh has black and white stripes.
🌱
grapefruit[greipfru:t]n.
A grapefruit is a fruit similar to an orange, but bigger and not as sweet. (Quả bưởi (tây) là một loại trái cây tương tự như quả cam, nhưng lớn hơn và không ngọt bằng.)
➔ Would you like a grapefruit with your breakfast?
🌱
hay[hei]n.
Hay is dry grass used to feed animals or used as a covering. (Cỏ khô là cỏ được phơi khô dùng làm thức ăn cho động vật hoặc dùng để làm lớp phủ.)
➔ I need to buy some more hay for the horse to sleep on.
🌱
horrified[hɔ:rəfaid]adj.
If you are horrified, you are very shocked and feel upset. (Nếu bạn "horrified" (kinh hoàng), bạn rất sốc và cảm thấy hoảng sợ.)
➔ I was horrified when I read about the old lady who was attacked.
🌱
kerosene[kerəsi:n]n.
Kerosene is a type of oil. It is used in some lamps and stoves. (Dầu hỏa là một loại dầu. Nó được sử dụng trong một số loại đèn và bếp.)
➔ Many people in poor countries cook on kerosene stoves.
🌱
loop[lu:p]n.
A loop is a line made into the shape of a circle. (Vòng lặp là một sợi dây được tạo thành hình tròn.)
➔ He made a loop with the rope and placed it over the post.
🌱
paddle[pædl]n.
A paddle is a piece of wood or plastic that moves a boat across water. (Mái chèo là một mảnh gỗ hoặc nhựa dùng để di chuyển thuyền trên mặt nước.)
➔ We need a paddle to help us move across the water.
🌱
raft[ræft]n.
A raft is a floating platform made from pieces of wood tied together. (Cái bè là một nền tảng nổi được làm từ những mảnh gỗ buộc lại với nhau.)
➔ The man made a raft out of bamboo and floated out to sea.
🌱
sour[sauər]adj.
When something is sour, it has a sharp and unpleasant taste. (Khi một thứ gì đó "sour" (chua), nó có vị gắt và khó chịu.)
➔ I don't like lemons because I think they are too sour.
🌱
stake[steik]n.
A stake is a small, sharp piece of wood or metal that is put into the ground. (Cái cọc là một mảnh gỗ hoặc kim loại nhỏ, sắc nhọn được cắm xuống đất.)
➔ We marked our property by placing stakes into the ground.
🌱
steward[stju:ərd]n.
A steward is a person like a waiter who serves food on planes and ships. (Người phục vụ (tiếp viên) là một người giống như bồi bàn phục vụ đồ ăn trên máy bay và tàu thủy.)
➔ The steward is bringing some tea.
🌱
string[striŋ]n.
String is a thin piece of fabric or rope. (Sợi dây là một đoạn vải hoặc dây thừng mỏng.)
➔ I found a large ball of string.
🌱
thorn[θɔ:rn]n.
A thorn is a sharp part of a plant. (Cái gai là một phần sắc nhọn của cây.)
➔ Be careful of the thorns when you pick the roses!
🌱
wreck[rek]v.
To wreck something means to destroy or ruin it. ("Wreck" một thứ gì đó có nghĩa là phá hủy hoặc làm hỏng nó.)
➔ The teenagers wrecked the house for no reason at all.

sections.title: Exercise 2
sections.content: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content:
Tom was promoted, and now he is an important sea officer that controls military ships.
ad [ 11 ]

Some people thought that the meal was too sharp and unpleasant tasting.
so [ 12 ]

The oil in lamps and stoves is a very cheap form of heat.
ke [ 13 ]

Why did you steal the woman's bag? Don't you have a mind that understands what is wrong?
co [ 14 ]

Can you buy three yellow pieces of fruit that are like oranges from the supermarket please?
gr [ 15 ]

I hope that the waiter on the plane will bring some water soon.
st [ 16 ]

After lightning struck the tree, the forest turned into a burning blaze.
fi [ 17 ]

st [ 18 ]

questions.explanation: "an important sea officer that controls military ships" (một sĩ quan hải quân quan trọng điều khiển tàu quân sự) có nghĩa là "admiral" (đô đốc).
"sharp and unpleasant tasting" (có vị gắt và khó chịu) có nghĩa là "sour" (chua).
"oil in lamps and stoves" (dầu dùng trong đèn và bếp) có nghĩa là "kerosene" (dầu hỏa).
"a mind that understands what is wrong" (tâm trí hiểu được điều gì là sai trái) là "conscience" (lương tâm).
"pieces of fruit that are like oranges" (những quả giống như cam) là "grapefruits" (quả bưởi tây).
"waiter on the plane" (người phục vụ trên máy bay) là "steward" (tiếp viên).
"burning blaze" (ngọn lửa đang bốc cháy) tương ứng với tính từ "fiery" (bốc cháy dữ dội).
"thin rope" (sợi dây thừng mỏng) có nghĩa là "string" (sợi dây).
"dry grass" (cỏ khô) có nghĩa là "hay".
"line in the shape of a circle" (sợi dây có hình vòng tròn) có nghĩa là "loop" (vòng lặp).

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
Monkey Island

In the middle of the ocean, there is a small island shaped like an arc. Here, monkeys play on the beach and in the trees. But how did the monkeys get there?

Once, an English admiral was exploring Africa when he found hundreds of monkeys. The admiral's character was mean. He thought, "I could sell these monkeys and become very rich! I'm going to take them to England."

So the admiral set traps to catch the monkeys. He put stakes in the ground, tied string around them and made loops in the string. When the monkeys ran through the forest, their feet got caught in the loops, and they couldn't escape. Then the admiral put the monkeys in cages on his ship and sailed away.

The cages were small and uncomfortable. There was no soft hay for the monkeys to sleep on. Instead, they slept on branches with sharp thorns that cut into the monkeys' flesh. For dinner, he gave them tiny pieces of sour grapefruit to eat. The monkeys grew hungry and weak.

But one day, the admiral hired a new steward. He was a kind man with a good conscience. He was horrified to see the thin monkeys in the cages. So one night he let them out.

The monkeys ran and played all over the ship! They attacked the admiral and the steward and ate their food. They completely wrecked the ship. One monkey ran into a kerosene lamp, and it fell over. The ship caught fire and began to sink! The whole crew was lost except for the monkeys.

After the accident, the monkeys jumped onto a raft. They floated away from the fiery blaze of the ship. In the morning, they saw a little island in the distance. The monkeys used a piece of wood as a paddle, and they went toward it. They found the island shaped like an arc. They felt so happy to find a new home, and they still live there today.

sections.title: Part A
sections.content: Mark each statement T for true or F for false. Rewrite the false statements to make them true.

questions.content: The admiral thought that selling the monkeys would make him rich.
questions.explanation: T. Dựa vào đoạn văn: 'He thought, "I could sell these monkeys and become very rich!"'

questions.content: The admiral caught the monkeys using loops of string and stakes.
questions.explanation: T. Theo đoạn văn: "He put stakes in the ground, tied string around them and made loops in the string."

questions.content: The admiral put hay in the monkeys' cages.
questions.explanation: F. Theo đoạn văn: "There was no soft hay for the monkeys to sleep on. Instead, they slept on branches with sharp thorns..." Câu sửa lại: The admiral put branches with sharp thorns in the monkeys' cages.

questions.content: The steward had no conscience.
questions.explanation: F. Theo đoạn văn: "He was a kind man with a good conscience." Câu sửa lại: The steward had a good conscience.

questions.content: The admiral was horrified because the monkeys were muscular.
questions.explanation: F. Theo đoạn văn: "He [the steward] was horrified to see the thin monkeys in the cages." Câu sửa lại: The steward was horrified because the monkeys were thin and weak.

questions.content: The monkeys jumped on a raft after the accident.
questions.explanation: T. Theo đoạn văn: "After the accident, the monkeys jumped onto a raft."

sections.title: Part B
sections.content: Answer the questions.

questions.content: Which adjective describes the admiral's character?
questions.explanation: Mean. Dựa vào đoạn văn: 'The admiral's character was mean.'

questions.content: Where did the admiral plan to take the monkeys?
questions.explanation: To England. Dựa vào đoạn văn: 'I\'m going to take them to England.'

questions.content: What did the monkeys eat while they were in the cages?
questions.explanation: Grapefruit. Dựa vào đoạn văn: 'For dinner, he gave them tiny pieces of sour grapefruit to eat.'

questions.content: What shape was the island that the monkeys found?
questions.explanation: An arc. Dựa vào đoạn văn: 'They found the island shaped like an arc.'
